subject: Audit + BYOK: short-term evidence path and SSO logs (triage)
messages:
From: Erin Mills <erin.mills@clearwave.health>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@clearwave.health
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: evidence & short-term retention options for BYOK pilot

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the BYOK pilot conversation yesterday. Our security team asked for a minimal evidence bundle that proves: (1) audit log capture for tokenized inference, (2) key custodianship/rotation records for the customer-provided key, and (3) SSO authentication events tied to the session IDs we're seeing.

We are not asking for full log exports yet — just a short-term path to satisfy an internal control review for a 30-day pilot. Specific asks from our side: 
- Sample audit log extract (last 72 hours) with field mapping to our schema (timestamp, request_id, model, route, actor_id)
- Rotation proof or key-change event from your KMS/audit (approx timestamps, operator id)
- SSO event snapshot showing login events and assertion IDs for a small set of test users

Can Redwood provide a lightweight evidence package or point to an operational playbook we can follow? If you have a template intake form, please send it — legal would like to see minimal redaction guidance.

I attached the internal request spreadsheet (initial-evidence-req.csv) to give you our field expectations. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Erin
Director of InfoSec | ClearWave Health

[attachment: initial-evidence-req.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Mills <erin.mills@clearwave.health>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & short-term retention options for BYOK pilot

Erin — thanks for the clear asks and the spreadsheet, that's very helpful. We can provide a scoped evidence bundle for a 30-day pilot. I'm looping in Soojin (security ops) and Karthik (product/infrastructure) to propose the minimal operational path and ownership.

Next steps from our side:
- Soojin to propose two viable evidence paths (fast/low-effort and conservative/forensic-ready)
- Karthik to estimate engineering effort and whether we can reuse the ephemeral-evidence export we piloted with another customer
- I will send the Redwood intake form (attached) for your legal team to review redaction and PII handling guidance

Happy to keep this async but also open to 30m to align if needed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Product Ops | Redwood Inference

[attachment: evidence-intake-form.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: proposed triage for ClearWave evidence request

Marissa / team — reading Erin's spreadsheet and Marissa's note, here are two pragmatic paths we can offer. Quoting Erin above: 

> "Sample audit log extract (last 72 hours) with field mapping to our schema (timestamp, request_id, model, route, actor_id)"

Path A — Quick scope (recommended for pilot, low risk) 
- What: 72-hour audit extract (JSON lines) filtered to test tenant + test actor IDs; include timestamp, request_id, model, route, actor_id, keystore_event_id
- TTL: short-lived S3 object with 30-day retention, access via presigned URL (audit trail of URL issuance)
- Security controls: redaction of query text/embedding vectors, redact PII per intake form
- Owner: Soojin (security ops) to assemble; infra task minimal (use existing export job)
- Estimated effort: 1-2 engineer-days to parameterize export and add KMS-event stitching
- Risk notes: does not include full KMS logs (we will supply KMS rotation event summary instead)

Path B — Forensic-ready (longer runway) 
- What: Full audit export (7 days), KMS rotation event records + signed attestations, SSO assertion logs with assertion IDs mapped to session IDs
- TTL: archived to secure bucket, limited access, 90-day retention
- Owner: product + security + legal review; requires minor contract amendment or AUP addendum
- Estimated effort: 4-6 engineer-days, plus legal sign-off on retention/PII handling

Operational asks / quick blockers:
- KMS event stitching: we need a way to map the customer's supplied CMK id to our audit event stream (I can prototype a script but will need infra access)
- SSO slices: Karthik, can you confirm our assertion logging granularity (do we capture assertion ID in the session trace?)
- Intake validation: Grace, can you review the intake form and redaction checklist so we can give ClearWave a clear path for PII?

I'll draft a minimal playbook and attach it (proposed-playbook.md) so Erin has an option A checklist she can follow. If we pick Path A, I can produce the artifact within 48 hours of tenant/test account details.

Thanks,
Soojin
Security Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

[attachment: proposed-playbook.md]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Mills <erin.mills@clearwave.health>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit + BYOK: short-term evidence path and SSO logs (triage)

Erin — appreciate the quick turnaround from your side. Summary and decision:

- We propose starting with Path A (Quick scope) for the 30-day pilot. This minimizes engineering lift and addresses your control review needs.
- Deliverables: 72-hour audit extract + KMS rotation summary + SSO event snapshot for provided test users. Artifacts will be delivered as presigned S3 objects and a short mapping doc.
- Timeline: Soojin can produce the export within 48 hours once you share the test tenant and actor IDs. Karthik estimates ~1.5 engineer-days to parameterize and run the job.
- Legal/redaction: Grace will follow up with the intake form clarifications by EOD Monday to confirm PII redaction defaults.

Action items:
- Erin: send test tenant IDs and 3 test actor emails (reply to this thread)
- Soojin: produce Path A checklist and run prototype export when tenant details are available
- Karthik: book 2 engineering days on infra sprint to support the export job
- Marissa: I'll coordinate sign-off and loop in Partnerships if we require escrow store (partners@cloud-escrow.com)

If everyone agrees, I'll block a 30-minute sync Monday to confirm the intake form and distribution channel.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Product Ops | Redwood Inference
